name: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana
benefit:
***Assistance provided under different components of Scheme:***
***Modified Market Development Assistance (MMDA):***

  - Subsidy @ 35% on Prime Cost for Cotton/Muslin, Wool and Polyvastra and @ 20% on Prime Cost for Silk Khadi

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a Khadi artisan or Khadi Institution registered with KVIC or KVIB. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a valid Aadhaar card or government-issued ID. 1. One person per family is eligible under the scheme. 1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from any other government scheme for the same purpose. 1. Preference is given to SC/ST, women, unemployed youth, and BPL category applicants. 1. The beneficiaries may be identified by KVIC, KVIBs, NGOs, DICs, FPOs, or Khadi Institutions.
